chunks: Hadith 4902 — The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Whoever desires continuance, though there is no permanence, should take the morning meal early, make the footwear good, lighten the cloak, and reduce intimacy with women."
It was said, "O Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, what is the lightness of the cloak?" He said, "Few debts."

key_terms.الْغَدَاءَ: the morning meal or early food

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about habits connected to longevity and avoiding debt?
ai.summary: This hadith presents practical counsels associated with preserving one's strength and extending one's stay in life, while reminding that no worldly permanence truly exists. It joins bodily habits, marital restraint, and financial moderation, and explains metaphorically that a 'light cloak' means carrying little debt.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4902 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever desires longevity, though there is no permanence, should have an early breakfast, wear well-made shoes, wear a light cloak, and reduce intimacy with women."
It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), what is meant by wearing a light cloak?"
Imam (as) replied: "It means having little debt."
